reason:
Fixed exceptional loop issue in HAL_UART_IRQHandler. The original function had complex hardware register access and interrupt flag checking that caused infinite loops in emulation. The new implementation:
1. Completely removes all hardware register reads (isrflags, cr1its, cr3its, etc.)
2. Uses state-based logic to determine interrupt handling
3. Calls HAL_BE_In for data reception when in receive mode
4. Properly handles all major interrupt types (RXNE, TXE, TC, errors, IDLE)
5. Maintains callback functionality for compatibility
6. Returns immediately after handling each case to prevent fall-through
7. Avoids recursive calls by not calling functions that might trigger interrupts
This should eliminate the exceptional loop while maintaining basic functionality for emulation.
